claim: Four independently SHA-verified original retail Crunch Texture2D samples, PathIDs390 (DXT1Crunched wrestler), 1407 (DXT5Crunched weapon), 6308 (DXT1Crunched gradient), and 15464 (DXT5Crunched face), are successfully transcoded by the exact pinned Binomial Crunch standalone native crnd_unpack_begin/crnd_unpack_level v1.04 source to conventional BC1/BC3 blocks. Every original CRN source header/data CRC16 matches, every native output block count equals its original image dimensions, native block SHA256 values are pinned, and two independent pixel decoders (custom BC1/BC3 and Pillow DDS) yield byte-for-byte identical RGBA for all four full first mips. This establishes recovered source-image pixel data and NOT Unity retail rendered orientation, shader, full Sprite layer assembly, or animation behavior.
